$description: Steward Display - Product Theme Overrides. Lobby and hallway signage. The admin keeps ChMS's warm parchment so a church moving between the two feels at home; the accent is violet so Display reads as its own product on a navy banner. Borders and muted text are darker than ChMS's because a signage editor is used standing up, at arm's length, and its borders delimit drop zones that must clear 3:1.
